# The only third-party Python package anything under tools/ imports.
#
# Everything else those scripts use - argparse, difflib, http.client, json,
# pathlib, re, shutil, socket, subprocess, tempfile - is in the standard library,
# which is why this file has one line in it.
#
# PyYAML is what parses contract/contract.yaml in tools/contract-compiler/.
# conformance/ parses the same file in JavaScript without a package: see the
# hand-written parser in conformance/contract/read-wire-contract-yaml.mjs, which
# is deliberate, so a generator that drifts from the contract cannot make a
# nonconformant host look conformant.
#
# Pinned to the version the developer machine this was verified on has installed.
PyYAML==6.0.3
